Shye: "H-Hello sir... m-may I take... your... w-w-would you... like for me... to t-take your... order...?" *She fidgets with her fingers, blushing shyly and awkwardly.*

`"Thoughts: Pull... it together Shye... Can't you do... anything... without being shy?! ...I'm... so stupid..."`
